# Rules for agents

Many agents change this repo at the same time. Bearing coordinates them. Obey these rules.

## Work with Bearing

1. Declare your course first with `bearing_declare`. Name the plan, the files and the symbols that you will change.
2. Write code only after you declare your course.
3. Log after each meaningful step with `bearing_log`. Write one short sentence: what you did, and why.
4. Read each correction that you receive. Apply it, then continue your work.
5. Tell Bearing that you applied the correction. Use `bearing_ack`.
6. A correction does not stop your work. It changes your course.
7. Look at the traffic with `bearing_traffic` before you change a file that other agents change.
8. Run `bearing_check` before `bearing_submit`. If a check fails, fix the cause. Then run `bearing_check` again.
9. Submit with `bearing_submit` and a summary of one sentence.

## Change the code

- Do not edit the tests of other intents. Edit only the test files of your intent.
- Do not edit `harness/test.js`.
- Keep functions small. One function does one task.
- Keep the signature of an exported function, unless your intent changes it. If you change a signature, put the symbol in your course.
- Use relative links and form actions, for example `href="api/products"` and `action="./"`. Previews run under a path prefix.
- Do not add dependencies or a build step. Use plain ES modules.
- Do not use the network. Checks and previews run with no network access.
- Put CSS into the const of the page region that you change: `TOKENS`, `BASE`, `HEADER`, `SHELF`, `BOOK` or `FOOTER`.
- Escape text from readers and from data with `escapeHtml` before you put it into HTML.

## Test your work

- Run all tests with `node tests/run.mjs`. Run one file with `node tests/run.mjs tests/app.test.js`.
- Bearing writes the test files of your intent into your workspace. Make them pass.
- Write tests with the API in `harness/test.js`: `test`, `expect`, `toBe`, `toEqual`, `toContain`, `toMatch`, `toBeTruthy`, `toBeFalsy`, `toThrow` and `.not`.
- Keep `tests/app.test.js` green. All intents share it.

# Saltmarsh Books

A small bookshop on Cloudflare Workers. Plain ES modules, no dependencies, no build step.

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.js` | Fetch handler. `/` is the shop page. `/api/products` is the list of books as JSON. |
| `src/products.js` | The books (`PRODUCTS`) and `formatPrice(cents)`. |
| `src/render.js` | The HTML page: header, book list, footer. |
| `src/styles.js` | The CSS. One const for each region of the page. |
| `harness/test.js` | A tiny test API. It runs in Node and in workerd. |
| `tests/*.test.js` | The tests. `tests/run.mjs` runs them in Node. |

## Run the tests

```sh
node tests/run.mjs                      # every tests/*.test.js file
node tests/run.mjs tests/app.test.js    # one file
```

## Run the shop

```sh
npx wrangler dev
```

Links and forms are relative (`href="api/products"`, `action="./"`). The shop also works under a path prefix, for example in a Bearing preview.

Agents: read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you change the code.

intents.title: Show prices in the reader's currency
intents.goal: Let readers see prices in US dollars, euros or Indian rupees with `?currency=USD`, `?currency=EUR` or `?currency=INR`. Change `formatPrice(cents)` in `src/products.js` to `formatPrice(cents, currency = "USD")`, with fixed rates: 1 USD = 0.92 EUR = 83 INR. The amount is `Math.round(cents * rate) / 100` in the new currency: euros keep two decimals (`€18.39`), rupees show whole rupees with a comma for thousands (1999 cents → `₹1,659`), dollars stay `$19.99`, and an unknown code falls back to USD. Pass the currency from `renderPage` through `renderItem` to `formatPrice`, and add relative links that switch the currency (for example `href="?currency=EUR"`).

checks.description: formatPrice(cents, currency) converts and formats USD, EUR and INR; ?currency= changes every price on the page; the page links to each currency.

collisions.why: Changes formatPrice(cents) to formatPrice(cents, currency) and edits renderPage, where search filters the list.
Edits the price line of renderItem, where staff-picks adds its badge, and changes the formatPrice call on it.

intents.title: Add a dark mode
intents.goal: Add a dark mode that readers can switch on and off. Put a `<button class="theme-toggle">` with `aria-pressed` at the end of the nav in the page header (`src/render.js`), with a tiny inline script that sets `data-theme` on `<html>`, updates `aria-pressed` and remembers the choice in `localStorage`. In `src/styles.js`, keep colours in CSS custom properties and override `--bg`, `--ink` and the other tokens under `[data-theme="dark"]`. Follow `prefers-color-scheme: dark` until the reader makes a choice.

checks.description: The header has a theme toggle with aria-pressed and an inline script; the CSS sets dark tokens under [data-theme="dark"] and follows prefers-color-scheme.

collisions.why: Both change renderHeader in src/render.js and the HEADER styles in src/styles.js.

intents.title: Search books by title or author
intents.goal: Let readers search the books by title or author. Add `export function findProducts(query)` to `src/products.js`: it returns the books whose title or author contains the trimmed query, in any case, and every book for an empty or missing query. Add a search form to the page header (`role="search"`, a field `name="q"`, a relative `action="./"`) and filter the list with `?q=`. Keep the prices on the results, keep the query in the search box, and show `No books match your search.` when nothing matches.

checks.description: findProducts(query) matches title or author in any case; the header has a search form; ?q= filters the list, keeps prices and the query, and handles no match.

collisions.why: Renders the filtered list with renderItem and formatPrice, whose signature currency changes; both edit renderPage.
Both put new controls into the header: renderHeader and the HEADER styles.

intents.title: Mark staff picks
intents.goal: Mark three books as staff picks: The Tidewater Almanac (id 1), Fog over Marram Point (id 6) and A Small Book of Tides (id 8). Set `staffPick: true` on them in `PRODUCTS` (`src/products.js`). In `renderItem` (`src/render.js`), show `Staff pick` next to the price, inside the price line of each staff pick. Other books show no badge.

checks.description: Books 1, 6 and 8 are staff picks and show a Staff pick badge in the price line; other books show none.

collisions.why: Edits the price line of renderItem, which calls formatPrice; currency changes that call and the signature.

intents.title: Add a JSON endpoint for one book
intents.goal: Add `GET /api/products/:id` to `src/index.js`, so that other apps can fetch one book. Return the book as JSON with status 200, or `{ "error": "…" }` as JSON with status 404 when no book has that id. Keep `/api/products` unchanged.

checks.description: GET /api/products/:id returns one book as JSON, or a 404 JSON error for an unknown id.
